item.title: Shoin, Aruiwa Ushinawareta Yume no Monogatari.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Force
  • 発売日: 2000-07-15
  • スコア: 7.3/10 (117 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 書淫、或いは失われた夢の物語。
  • 英語名: Shoin, Aruiwa Ushinawareta Yume no Monogatari.

别名

  • 書淫、あるいは失われた夢の物語

あらすじ

Two scenarios:

Shoin: You play as N, whose true identity is x, a serial rapist; with your latest job, you go to a hotel where three women, Hinata, Yukari and Misa, are staying, and you have to rape them. However, the first morning a note appears in your room, from somebody who claims to be x.

item.title: Izayoi ~Hime Miko Senka~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Force
  • 発売日: 1999-11-05
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: イザヨイ ～姫巫女選歌～
  • 英語名: Izayoi Hime Miko Senka

あらすじ

Main character is a young man who lives in the mountains as a hermit. One day two girls lost their way and got to hero’s house. They insisted that they did not want to go home, and so they stayed in the mountains. On the night of that day main character felt a strange hypnotic impulse in his body and incredible lust force awakened in him.

item.title: Hajimete no Otsukai ~first adventure of little witch~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Force
  • 発売日: 1999-08-07
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はじめてのおつかい ～first adventure of little witch～
  • 英語名: Hajimete no Otsukai first adventure of little witch

あらすじ

Main character is a black cat Georges who lives with a witch in the forest house. One day master brought a little human girl Apple. 100 years passed and master decided that Apple should see the world. The cat was sent with her to bodyguard and counsel her. And so they set off.
